## Batch 9 complete

Authored the six items and both frontmatter-only pages, and updated the manifest, proof contracts, coverage, notes, cross-batch records, and Step 1 decisions. The authored statements passed a link-free check. I inspected the relevant passages in [Atiyah–Bott](https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~mmovshev/MAT570Spring2008/BOOKS/atiyahbott_moment.pdf), [Libine’s lecture notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0709.3615), and [Hori et al.’s book](https://www.claymath.org/library/monographs/cmim-1.pdf); all three PDFs are fetch-verified.

The local Borel conventions item is **ready**. The Gysin lemma, Euler-invertibility lemma, ABBV theorem, and both examples are **escalated** because their batch-8 prerequisites lack current Step 1 records. The Borel theorem’s statement and proof interface match the conditional use, and its base-property input is now in the manifest, but the theorem, character-localization item, and base-property item still lack readiness records. The character-localization item also has a stale note saying the batch-7 Borel definition lacks readiness, though that record is currently closed.

Scoped checks passed: strict proof contracts, proof layout, precheck, content policy, focused dependency closure, rendercheck, source fetch, and the assigned item-level calculation. The full-run dependency-level check still reports **50 empty scaffold inventories in other pairs**; proof-contract coverage also stops at the empty `aqft-smeft-heft` inventory. Those out-of-scope pages were left unchanged.

Details and record hashes are in the [batch-9 notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-9.notes.md), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-9.coverage.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-9.proof-contracts.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-9.cross-batch-dependencies.json).
